geometry_policy: Original generic authored meshes only; no tracing, copying, adapting or embedding publisher art. Source facts do not establish shape accuracy.

scene_assets.source_facts_and_limits: Bottle nominal capacity 100 mL; receiving tube nominal capacity 1.5 mL; filter pore designation 0.22 micrometre are factual labels, not mesh dimensions.
Two distinct identities: bottle aliquot and reference record. Refractometer service at its qualified reference wavelength; no imported manufacturer shape.

Logical inlet/outlet/bubble-trap/reversible-mount topology known. Source 22 microlitre chamber and about 300 picolitre optical region must be separate labels, not total handling volume. Full chip CAD unknown.
Two camera roles known. 50 micrometre SPP diameter and plate step heights may appear as factual scale labels only; no publisher-derived internal geometry, light ray or optics construction.
Authored record UI, immutable ID references and states. Must distinguish same-sample technical repeats, independent calibration runs and stored specimens.
Authored warnings; no pump controls with numerical setting and no real service activation.

global_requirements: No open-beam controls or manufacturing station

No source pixels or hidden answer overlays
